family: The fixed total Mishra-Santhanam affine-disperser family from proof.md: for each input length n use the explicit polynomial-time affine disperser f_n : {0,1}^n -> {0,1} for dimension d = O(log n) from Li [37]. The family is total and uniform because the disperser construction is explicit and works for every length n.
theorem: For this one total uniform polynomial-time family, hence in NP with empty witnesses, C_B2(f_n) >= (7/2)n - O(log n) at every sufficiently large integer length n=|x| in the full Li-Yang B2 model.
